name: id
label: Twitter user ID
description: Numeric Twitter user ID of the researcher. One row per researcher (N = 258,409); values are unique.
derivation: Taken from the Twitter profile data

name: is_migrated
label: Migrated to Mastodon
description: Outcome variable. 1 if the researcher created a Mastodon account in November or December 2022 (or reactivated one with no posts between January and October 2022) and posted more on Mastodon than on Twitter between account creation (or the first post after reactivation) and 31 December 2022; 0 otherwise. All posts count, including retweets, replies and reblogs. 3,990 researchers are coded 1.
derivation: Mastodon activity greater than Twitter activity over the same interval

name: is_returned
label: Returned to Twitter
description: TRUE if a migrated researcher posted more on Twitter than on Mastodon between 1 and 30 April 2023; FALSE otherwise. All non-migrated researchers are FALSE. 3,361 of the 3,990 migrated researchers are TRUE. Not used in the reported models.
derivation: Twitter activity in April 2023 greater than Mastodon activity in April 2023

name: is_os_endorsement
label: Open science endorsement
description: TRUE if the profile description contains "open science", "reproducibility", "reproducible", "open access", "open data", "open source" or "preregistration", or a spelling or word-form variant (17 case-insensitive patterns in config.yml). The Mastodon description is used for migrated researchers and the Twitter description otherwise; handles and URLs are removed before matching. 1,350 researchers are TRUE.
derivation: Regular expression match on the cleaned profile description

name: is_influencer
label: Potential influencer
description: 1 if the researcher is in the table of potential influencers: researchers with at least one original tweet containing a migration-related keyword, after manual removal of 12 accounts from the top 100 that were not researchers or not relevant. 9,359 researchers are coded 1. The paper's 10,742 potential influencers are those followed by at least one researcher in this table; 9,148 of them are in this file, the remaining 1,594 were removed because their Twitter or Mastodon timelines were missing. The other 211 influencers in this file are followed by no researcher.

name: SI_S
label: Strength (raw)
description: Mean influence score of the followed potential influencers that remained in the table after the research-topic filter (see SI_N). Negative values arise from followed anti-migration influencers. 0 for the 25,499 researchers with SI_N = 0.
derivation: Mean of influencer_influence_score_20-80_weighted over followed influencers

name: SI_N
label: Number of sources (raw)
description: Number of followed potential influencers that remained in the table after the research-topic filter (influencers without a research-related profile description or post were dropped before the social impact calculation). These are researchers who posted about the migration, not necessarily researchers who migrated. 25,499 researchers have SI_N = 0; 2,444 of them follow a potential influencer who did not survive the topic filter.
derivation: Count of followed influencers remaining in the table

name: SI_I
label: Immediacy (raw)
description: Mean Pearson correlation between the researcher's research-topic probability vector and the vectors of the followed influencers counted in SI_N. Topic vectors are per-person averages of zero-shot BERTopic document-topic probabilities over the profile description and research-related posts, using the OpenAlex topic list of Van Eck (2024) (4,521 rows, 4,510 unique labels, so the vectors have 4,510 dimensions). 0 for researchers with SI_N = 0.
derivation: Mean correlation of document-topic probability vectors

name: SI_S_abs_minmax_sign
label: Strength (scaled)
description: Absolute value of SI_S min-max scaled across researchers with at least one followed influencer, with the sign of SI_S restored afterwards; researchers with SI_N = 0 were set to 0 after scaling. Scaling used the table before 1,712 influencers with missing timelines were removed.
derivation: abs(SI_S) min-max scaled, multiplied by sign(SI_S)

name: SI_N_minmax
label: Number of sources (scaled)
description: SI_N min-max scaled across researchers with at least one followed influencer, i.e. (SI_N - 1) / (1688 - 1); researchers with SI_N = 0 were set to 0 after scaling. Consequently the 20,139 researchers with exactly one followed influencer also have SI_N_minmax = 0 and social_impact = 0. The maximum in this file is 0.975 because the researcher with 1,688 followed influencers was removed from the table after scaling (missing timeline).

name: SI_I_minmax
label: Immediacy (scaled)
description: SI_I min-max scaled to 0 to 1 across researchers with at least one followed influencer; researchers with SI_N = 0 were set to 0 after scaling.

name: social_impact
label: Social impact
description: Product of the three scaled components: SI_S_abs_minmax_sign x SI_N_minmax x SI_I_minmax. 0 whenever a component is 0 (including SI_N = 1, see SI_N_minmax); negative for 1,716 researchers whose strength is negative.

name: influencer_influence_score_20-80_weighted
label: Influence score
description: Influence score of the researcher in their role as potential influencer: 0.1 x followers count + 0.1 x listed count + (0.8 / 3) x (retweets + likes + mentions of their migration-related tweets), each metric divided by its maximum across influencers. Multiplied by -1 for manually identified anti-migration influencers (six among the paper's 10,742 potential influencers, five of them in this file). Only present for researchers with is_influencer = 1.
missing: missing for the 249,050 researchers with is_influencer = 0
derivation: Weighted sum of max-scaled Twitter metrics

name: SI_S_abs_minmax_sign_z
label: Strength (z)
description: z-standardized SI_S_abs_minmax_sign (mean 0, SD 1 across all 258,409 researchers). Not clipped in this file; analysis.R clips values at -10 and 10 in its copy for the components model and that model's SHAP values.

name: SI_N_minmax_z
label: Number of sources (z)
description: z-standardized SI_N_minmax (mean 0, SD 1 across all researchers). Not clipped in this file; analysis.R clips values at -10 and 10 in its copy for the components model and that model's SHAP values.

name: SI_I_minmax_z
label: Immediacy (z)
description: z-standardized SI_I_minmax (mean 0, SD 1 across all researchers).

name: social_impact_z
label: Social impact (z)
description: z-standardized social_impact (mean 0, SD 1 across all researchers). Predictor in the social impact model.
